name: Aloha Animal Outreach — Full Digital Ecosystem
summary: A nonprofit came to me needing everything — a public website, a direct donation system, a merch store, and a custom internal app for field operations. I designed and built the entire digital ecosystem from scratch.
problem: Aloha Animal Outreach conducts monthly outreach to unhoused communities and their pets across O'ahu, but their digital infrastructure couldn't keep up. The website was a dated WordPress build with no donation flow or mobile optimization. Field data lived in six disconnected AppSheet spreadsheets with no real-time alerts, no dog timelines, and no way to flag urgent situations. There was no merch presence and no passive revenue stream beyond one-time donations.
whatIDid:
Designed and built a three-part ecosystem:

Public website — A ground-up rebuild in Astro with direct Stripe donation integration, Netlify Forms for volunteer and partner inquiries, and a new Partners page targeting corporate sponsors.

Kahu (field operations app) — A custom internal app with a situations-based data model built specifically for dogs living long-term with unhoused owners, not the linear intake-to-adoption flow of standard rescue software.

Merch store — A Printful-integrated Shopify store handling passive revenue with zero fulfillment overhead.
outcome: A production-ready public website with direct Stripe donation integration. Kahu — a fully deployed custom field operations app replacing six disconnected spreadsheets, now used in monthly outreach operations. A Shopify merch store with zero fulfillment overhead. One client. Three live products.

name: Nike Retail Brand Marketing
summary: Led retail marketing and store design programs for Nike North America, managing $10M+ in annual budgets across in-store signage, digital displays, and specialty store builds up to 6,000 square feet.
problem: Nike needed consistent, on-brand retail experiences executed at scale across North America, spanning everything from in-store digital components to full specialty store builds, on tight timelines and under significant budget scrutiny.
whatIDid: Owned end-to-end execution across six years of retail programs. Managed $10M+ in annual budgets, defined project scope, and led communication across designers, agencies, vendors, and construction teams. Delivered specialty store builds up to 6,000 square feet.
outcome: Consistent, on-time, on-budget delivery across hundreds of locations. Built the vendor relationships and communication systems that supported Nike's North American retail brand growth for six years.

name: Apple Retail Experience
summary: Produced shop-in-shop, digital, print, and retail space presentations for Apple's key retail partners across North America. End-to-end, from creative inception through physical installation.
problem: Apple's retail partner program required brand-perfect installations across multiple retail environments simultaneously, at Apple's exacting standards.
whatIDid: Led the full creative and production process for shop-in-shop displays, digital components, print marketing, and retail space presentations. Managed cross-functional teams including project managers, surveyors, field operations, and construction crews. Drove product and marketing program approvals with key retail partners and orchestrated multiple vendor relationships to ensure seamless execution.
outcome: Delivered retail partner experiences across North America on time, on budget, and to Apple's brand standards — consistently.

name: LaunchKit
summary: A productized template system for founders who need to launch fast. Designed, built, and distributed — from brand kits to digital download storefronts.
problem: Solo founders and small business owners consistently stall between having an idea and getting it live, overwhelmed by the number of decisions, tools, and steps involved in launching a digital product or website.
whatIDid: Designed and built LaunchKit as a productized system: Canva templates, brand kits, and digital tools structured to move founders from concept to launch without getting stuck. Handled product design, distribution setup, and the full launch strategy.
outcome: A growing catalog of digital products sold via Etsy and Shopify, built on a repeatable system that scales without custom client work.

name: Shauna Digital — Client Portal
summary: A custom client portal built for my own practice — because nothing off the shelf did what I needed.
problem: Running a small design and development practice means managing projects, files, feedback, invoices, and client communication across too many disconnected tools. Every client portal product I evaluated was either too generic, too expensive, or not built for how I actually work.
whatIDid: Designed and built a full-stack client portal from scratch using React, TypeScript, Supabase, and Stripe. The portal handles the entire client lifecycle: onboarding, project phase tracking, file delivery with approval workflows, invoice creation and payment, asset uploads, messaging, and email notifications. Clients get a clean, branded experience. I get a single system that runs my practice.
outcome: A live production application at portal.shauna.digital. Every new client I onboard uses it from day one. Built in six weeks alongside active client work.
